captions.linkedin:
AQR built a multi-billion-dollar book on this factor. We're about to steal the recipe. 📊

Quality Minus Junk (Asness, Frazzini & Pedersen, RFS 2019) is the most replicated defensive factor in modern quant finance. Tested across 25 countries. Robust to definition. Negatively correlated with value.

Here's the 4-pillar quality score:

🔹 PROFITABILITY. Gross profit to assets, cash-flow margins.
🔹 GROWTH. Trailing 5-year growth in profitability measures.
🔹 SAFETY. Low beta, low leverage, low earnings volatility.
🔹 PAYOUT. Shareholder-friendly dividends and buybacks.

The trade:

🔹 SCORE every stock on the composite.
🔹 LONG the top 30%, SHORT the bottom 30% (the "junk").
🔹 Size-neutral, value-weighted, monthly rebalance.
🔹 Replicate across 24 developed countries for geographic diversification.

Why it works: the market underprices boring, profitable, low-volatility businesses because they aren't lottery tickets. The behavioral preference for upside-skewed stocks leaves a quiet premium on quality.

Why it matters: quality is defensive. It tends to hold up in stress periods while junk gets dumped. That asymmetry is the whole point.
